<script>document.querySelectorAll('.map-legend-head').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var g=b.parentElement;var items=g.querySelector('.map-legend-items');var open=b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!open));items.classList.toggle('collapsed',open);});});var lt=document.getElementById('map-legend-toggle');if(lt){lt.addEventListener('click',function(){var lg=document.getElementById('map-legend');var hidden=lg.classList.toggle('legend-hidden');lt.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!hidden));});}document.querySelectorAll('.map-legend-items li').forEach(function(li) { li.addEventListener('click', function() { var group = li.closest('.map-legend-group').querySelector('.map-legend-head').textContent.trim(); if (li.closest('.map-legend-group').getAttribute('data-group') === 'landmarks') return; var text = li.textContent.trim(); var titleIncludes = ''; var selector = ''; if (text.includes('Alpha')) titleIncludes = '(alpha)'; else if (text.includes('Beta')) titleIncludes = '(beta)'; else if (text.includes('Gamma')) titleIncludes = '(gamma)'; else if (li.getAttribute('data-galaxy')) selector = '.zonemap-node-' + li.getAttribute('data-galaxy'); else return; var nodes = []; if (selector) { document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(function(n) { nodes.push(n.closest('a') || n); }); } else if (titleIncludes) { document.querySelectorAll('.zonemap a title').forEach(function(t) { if (t.textContent.includes(titleIncludes)) nodes.push(t.closest('a')); }); } if (!nodes.length) return; var svg = document.querySelector('svg.zonemap'); var wrap = svg.closest('.zonemap-wrap'); var minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity; nodes.forEach(function(n) { var shape = n.tagName === 'a' ? n.querySelector('circle,rect') : n; if (!shape) return; var cx = parseFloat(shape.getAttribute('cx') || shape.getAttribute('x')); var cy = parseFloat(shape.getAttribute('cy') || shape.getAttribute('y')); var r = parseFloat(shape.getAttribute('r') || shape.getAttribute('width')) || 0; if (!isNaN(cx) && !isNaN(cy)) { minX = Math.min(minX, cx - r); minY = Math.min(minY, cy - r); maxX = Math.max(maxX, cx + r); maxY = Math.max(maxY, cy + r); } }); if (minX === Infinity) return; var pad = 40; minX -= pad; minY -= pad; maxX += pad; maxY += pad; var bw = maxX - minX; var bh = maxY - minY; var rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect(); var vb = svg.getAttribute('viewBox').split(' '); var vw = parseFloat(vb[2]), vh = parseFloat(vb[3]); var base_s = Math.min(rect.width / vw, rect.height / vh); var cx = minX + bw / 2; var cy = minY + bh / 2; var ox = (rect.width - vw * base_s) / 2; var oy = (rect.height - vh * base_s) / 2; var px = ox + cx * base_s; var py = oy + cy * base_s; var s = Math.min(rect.width / (bw * base_s), rect.height / (bh * base_s)); if (s > 4) s = 4; var tx = (rect.width / 2 - px) * s; var ty = (rect.height / 2 - py) * s; if (!wrap._zoomState) wrap._zoomState = { s: 1, tx: 0, ty: 0 }; wrap._zoomState.s = s; wrap._zoomState.tx = tx; wrap._zoomState.ty = ty; svg.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease'; svg.style.transform = 'translate(' + tx + 'px,' + ty + 'px) scale(' + s + ')'; setTimeout(function() { svg.style.transition = ''; }, 500); nodes.forEach(function(n) { var shape = n.tagName === 'a' ? n.querySelector('circle,rect') : n; if (!shape) return; var oldStroke = shape.style.stroke || ''; var oldWidth = shape.style.strokeWidth || ''; shape.style.transition = 'stroke 0.2s, stroke-width 0.2s'; shape.style.stroke = '#fff'; shape.style.strokeWidth = '4px'; setTimeout(function() { shape.style.stroke = oldStroke; shape.style.strokeWidth = oldWidth; setTimeout(function() { shape.style.transition = ''; }, 200); }, 1000); }); }); });</script></div>
